newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - July 31.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - July 31.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - U.S. expected to give Taiwan president transit visa.
Ruling Nationalist Party completes nominations for year-end elections.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - President Lee Teng-hui schedules meeting with Taiwan governor James Soong.
New premier should be able to help Vice President Lien Chan win next presidential election, sources say.
LIBERTY TIMES - Japan punishes Nomura Securities and Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank for alleged influence-peddling in stock market.
Taipei city council passes law governing councillors' pension funds, draws public anger.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - President group to invest T$10 billion in holding firm.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Central bank vows again to keep hands off foreign exchange market following Taiwan dollar's recent sharp depreciation.
Central bank expected to maintain not-too-loose monetary policy.
